 synthetic dependency-scoped trigger capture
Source/API matrix: 62.0 and 67.0, one check-only package per scenario.
Every package includes the independent @IsTest class R131IndependentTest.

invalid-public / valid-public: explicit public class and public static method, illegal String-to-Integer assignment / repaired Integer assignment.
invalid-default / valid-default: omitted class and method access modifiers, same assignment twins.

Each package contains these distinct trigger source units on Account before insert:
Call: static method qualifier.
Type: local type position.
Constructor: constructor type position.
CaseCall / CaseType / CaseConstructor: mixed-case class/method spelling twins.
Literal / Comment: matching name bytes without a bound reference.
Empty: empty trigger boundary.
Unreachable: bound reference in a constant-false branch boundary.

The valid-public package is also deployed and exercised through anonymous DML and synchronous @IsTest at both source APIs. The valid-default row repairs only the assignment; omitted top-level class visibility still rejects the class. Invalid and invalid-visibility packages cannot execute natively; their oracle is check-only deployment, not runtime.
